scope: Resolve Data05 (EMAS / EU Ecolabel) from PARTIAL to VERIFIED: locate and pull-test the machine-readable sources for the EU EMAS register and the EU Ecolabel catalogue, and count certified organisations in Greece and the Ionian Islands (EL62); and locate the machine-readable source for Data24 (protected land): the EEA ArcGIS REST MapServer for Natura 2000 / CDDA protected sites.

evidence.name: EU EMAS register - public registration list (REST)
evidence.method: GET (discovered via green-forum.ec.europa.eu/green-business/emas/emas-register_en -> 'ACCESS THE EMAS REGISTER' -> webgate EMAS2 app; columnDefinition endpoint at .../rest/registration/columnDefinition)
evidence.schema_observation: JSON array of registration records; fields include registrationNumber, organisationName, organisationCountryName, city, postalCode, sitesCount, nacesAsString, registrationDate, nextEnvStatementDate, organisationWebsite, email, phone. Full list 14,650,764 bytes.
evidence.note: Full EU register: 4,523 records across 27 countries. Greece: 37 registered organisations (0 in the Ionian Islands EL62 by city/name keyword match). The register UI's 'download in Excel' is a client-side DataTables excelHtml5 button over this same REST list; the underlying data source is this JSON endpoint. NOT a PDF/download document.

evidence.name: EU Ecolabel catalogue - most-recent export (CSV)
evidence.method: GET (discovered via green-business.ec.europa.eu/eu-ecolabel_en -> EU Ecolabel catalogue -> environmental-data.ec.europa.eu/ecolabel/index.html -> most-recent-export.csv)
evidence.schema_observation: Semicolon-delimited CSV; columns product_or_service, licence_number, group_name, code_type, code_value, product_or_service_name, decision, expiration_date, company_name, company_country, vat_number, extract_date. Full export 17,153,575 bytes, extract_date 2026-10-01.
evidence.note: Full catalogue: 89,298 licences. Greece: 450 licences (mostly decorative paints 400, lubricants 32 - none in the 'Tourist accommodation' group). 'Tourist accommodation' group total 1,009 licences (France 382, Austria 262, Italy 86, ... Greece 0). Ionian Islands EL62: 0 tourist-accommodation licences.

evidence.name: Natura 2000 sites - EEA ArcGIS REST MapServer (ProtectedSites)
evidence.method: GET (ArcGIS REST query: layer 0 Habitats, layer 1 Birds; where=SITECODE LIKE 'GR22%')
evidence.schema_observation: ArcGIS MapServer with 3 polygon layers (0 Habitats pSCI/SCI/SAC, 1 Birds SPA, 2 union). Fields: SITECODE, SITENAME, MS, Area_ha, Area_km2, Shape_Area, geometry. Spatial reference WGS84 Web Mercator (wkid 3857).
evidence.note: Ionian Islands (SITECODE GR22): 18 Habitats sites (311,935.9 ha total) + 8 Birds sites (67,391.9 ha total). Area_ha is full site area incl. marine component, so the protected-LAND % still needs a terrestrial/marine split + clip to EL62 (~2,300 km2) + union of Habitats & Birds. CDDA/NatDA services also reachable (NatDAv24_Dyna_WM, CDDAv21_Dyna_WM - HTTP 200).
